candidates.change_summary: Flip the first branch condition to _BASE_RESERVE_ > _BASE_TARGET_ so the reset happens in the opposite reserve/target situation.
In the first branch, assign _QUOTE_RESERVE_ instead of _BASE_RESERVE_ to _BASE_TARGET_.
Flip the second branch condition to _QUOTE_RESERVE_ >= _QUOTE_TARGET_ so the reset triggers in the opposite situation.
Delete the _BASE_TARGET_ assignment in the second branch so _BASE_TARGET_ is left unchanged when that branch fires.
Delete the entire first if block so a BELOW_ONE state with _BASE_RESERVE_ < _BASE_TARGET_ is no longer corrected.
